'''María Teresa Lozano Imízcoz''' (born July 31, 1946) is a Spanish emeritus professor and mathematician. She studies [[topology]] principally in three dimensions. She has been awarded a [[Royal Spanish Mathematical Society]] (RSME) medal for her career and as a trailblazer for women to be involved in mathematical research.<ref name=n1/><ref name=n2/>

==Life==
Lozano was born in [[Pamplona]] in 1946.<ref name=knots/> In 1969 she obtained a degree and five years later she completed her doctorate in mathematics at the [[University of Zaragoza]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=206078}}</ref> Her postdoctoral work began at the [[University of Wisconsin]], where she was an honorary fellow.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.rac.es/2/2_ficha.php?id=456|title=Real Academia de Ciencias Exactas, Físicas y Naturales - Académicos - Académicos|website=www.rac.es|access-date=2019-11-26|archive-date=2018-12-31|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181231194404/http://www.rac.es/2/2_ficha.php?id=456|url-status=dead}}</ref> In 1978 she returned to Spain where she became a professor at the University of Zaragoza.

In 1990 she was made the Professor of Geometry and Topology. She was the first professor and the first director in her university's Faculty of Sciences. She was also the first emeritus professor of her faculty.<ref name=profe>{{Cite web|url=http://www.unizar.es/actualidad/vernoticia_ng.php?id=30860&idh=6948|title=La Real Sociedad Matemática Española distingue a la profesora María Teresa Lozano Imízcoz|website=www.unizar.es|access-date=2019-11-26}}</ref>

==Memberships==
In 1996 she became an Academician of the Royal Academy of Exact, Physical, Chemical and Natural Sciences of Zaragoza. In 2006 she became a Corresponding Academician of the [[Spanish Royal Academy of Sciences]].

In 2016 she was awarded the Royal Spanish Mathematical Society  (RSME) Medal in recognition of the 40 years that she had contributed to the mathematics profession. The citation mentioned her dissemination work and her studies with [[Hugh Michael Hilden]]<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Hilden|first1=H. M.|last2=Lozano|first2=M. T.|last3=Montesinos|first3=J. M.|last4=Whitten|first4=W. C.|date=1987-10-01|title=On universal groups and three-manifolds|journal=[[Inventiones Mathematicae]]|language=en|volume=87|issue=3|pages=441–456|doi=10.1007/BF01389236|issn=1432-1297|bibcode=1987InMat..87..441H|s2cid=121640666 }}</ref> and [[Vicente Montesinos]]<ref>{{Cite journal|author1=Hugh M. Hilden| author2=María Teresa Lozano|author3=José María Montesinos-Amilibia|title=On Volumes and Chern-Simons Invariants of Geometric 3-Manifolds|url=https://www.ms.u-tokyo.ac.jp/journal/pdf/jms030310.pdf|journal=J. Math. Sci. Univ. Tokyo |volume=3 |year=1996|pages=723–744}}</ref> on [[knot theory]] and [[3-manifold|3-dimensional topology]].<ref name=knots>{{Cite web|url=https://www.arbolmat.com/maria-teresa-lozano-imizcoz/|title=María Teresa Lozano Imízcoz|language=es|access-date=2019-11-26|archive-date=2021-02-12|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210212044237/https://www.arbolmat.com/maria-teresa-lozano-imizcoz/|url-status=dead}}</ref> The newspapers also mentioned her as a trailblazer for women to be involved in mathematical research.<ref name=n1>{{Cite news|title=Distincion Nacional a la mathematica...|date=13 July 2016|work=Newspaper of Aragon}}</ref><ref name=n2>{{Cite web|url=https://ciencias.unizar.es/noticia/medalla-de-la-rsme-para-maria-teresa-lozano-imizcoz|title=Medalla de la RSME para María Teresa Lozano Imízcoz {{!}} Facultad de Ciencias|website=ciencias.unizar.es|access-date=2019-11-26}}</ref>
